import openpyxl
import os

# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53161/1_53161_input.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Define the structure
# Agent Categories: rows 3-8, columns F-N (6-14) for categories 1-9
# Agent Schedule: rows 13-18, columns F-AE (6-31) for time slots
# Category Totals: rows 22-29, columns F-AE (6-31) - we need to fill this

# Get agent names from column E
agent_names = []
for row in range(3, 9):  # rows 3-8
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    agent_names.append(agent_name)

print(f"Agents: {agent_names}")

# Build agent categories dictionary
# agent_categories[agent_name][category_num] = 1 if agent handles that category
agent_categories = {}
for i, agent_name in enumerate(agent_names):
    row = 3 + i
    agent_categories[agent_name] = {}
    for cat_num in range(1, 9):  # Categories 1-8 (row 22-29 has 8 categories)
        col = 5 + cat_num  # F=6 for Category 1, G=7 for Category 2, etc.
        value = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        agent_categories[agent_name][cat_num] = 1 if value == '1' or value == 1 else 0

print(f"\nAgent Categories:")
for agent, cats in agent_categories.items():
    print(f"  {agent}: {cats}")

# Build agent schedule dictionary
# agent_schedule[agent_name][time_slot_col] = 1 if agent is working
agent_schedule = {}
for i, agent_name in enumerate(agent_names):
    row = 13 + i  # rows 13-18
    agent_schedule[agent_name] = {}
    for time_col in range(6, 32):  # F=6 to AE=31 (26 time slots)
        value = ws.cell(row=row, column=time_col).value
        agent_schedule[agent_name][time_col] = 1 if value == '1' or value == 1 else 0

print(f"\nAgent Schedule (first few time slots):")
for agent, schedule in agent_schedule.items():
    first_slots = {k: v for k, v in list(schedule.items())[:5]}
    print(f"  {agent}: {first_slots}")

# Calculate category totals for each time slot
# For each category (rows 22-29) and each time slot (columns F-AE)
# Count how many agents are working that time slot AND handle that category
print(f"\nCalculating category totals...")

for cat_num in range(1, 9):  # Categories 1-8
    output_row = 21 + cat_num  # row 22 for Category 1, row 23 for Category 2, etc.
    
    for time_col in range(6, 32):  # F=6 to AE=31
        total = 0
        
        # For each agent, check if they're working this time slot and handle this category
        for agent_name in agent_names:
            is_working = agent_schedule[agent_name].get(time_col, 0)
            handles_category = agent_categories[agent_name].get(cat_num, 0)
            
            if is_working and handles_category:
                total += 1
        
        # Write the total to the cell
        ws.cell(row=output_row, column=time_col, value=total)
    
    print(f"  Category {cat_num} (row {output_row}): calculated")

# Save the output
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/53161_4_01ccb999/1_53161_output.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

print(f"\nOutput saved to: {output_path}")

# Verify the output
print("\nVerifying output (first few columns of Category Totals):")
for row in range(22, 30):
    row_data = []
    for col in range(5, 11):  # E to J
        cell_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        row_data.append(str(cell_value) if cell_value is not None else '')
    print(f"Row {row}: {row_data}")
